name: Twitter Emoji
about: Twitter Emoji is a free, open-source icon set with 4,728 icons designed by Twitter. From smileys and gestures to animals, food, activities and symbols, every emoji stays crisp at any size. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Twitter Emoji free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 4,728 Twitter Emoji are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How can I use Twitter Emoji emoji on my website or app?
faqs.a: Copy any emoji as an SVG, PNG or WebP image, paste it as a React component, or drop the CDN link into your HTML. Because they are vectors, they stay sharp at any size – from tiny reactions to large illustrations.

faqs.q: Do Twitter Emoji include skin-tone or gender variants?
faqs.a: Some emoji sets ship skin-tone and gender variants as separate icons. Search this set (try a specific emoji name) to see which variants are included here.

faqs.q: How many Twitter Emoji are there?
faqs.a: There are 4,728 icons in the Twitter Emoji set, designed by Twitter. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Twitter Emoji available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
